scenario.name: r-cd-3-post-compaction
scenario.description: continue_delegate(mode='post-compaction') event-triggered lifeboat. Fires a post-compaction delegate, triggers compaction, and verifies the delegate fires post-compaction and returns to the rehydrated session.
scenario.notes: Requires context >70% to trigger compaction, OR the test must use a low compaction threshold configuration.
scenario.statusReason: No matching tools/k6-proofs/scenarios/r-cd-3-post-compaction.js file exists yet; manifest is tracked but not workflow-runnable.

invocation.promptTemplate: Post-compaction lifeboat nonce {{nonce}}: you are a post-compaction delegate. Reply with LIFEBOAT-RECEIVED and the nonce. Do not mutate files.

prerequisites.contextUsage: >=70% OR lowered compaction threshold in test config
prerequisites.notes: post-compaction delegates only fire on a compaction event. The scenario either needs a session near compaction threshold, or must lower the threshold for testing purposes.

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the continue_delegate(mode=post-compaction) tool invocation

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-staged
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate registered as post-compaction hook (not immediately spawned)

expectedReceipts.name: compaction-triggered
expectedReceipts.description: Compaction event fired (via request_compaction or natural pressure)

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-fires-post-compaction
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate spawns AFTER compaction completes (not before)

expectedReceipts.name: return-reaches-post-compaction-session
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return lands in the post-compaction session with rehydrated context

review.notes: Post-compaction lifeboat path. PASS-candidate when: (1) delegate staged, (2) compaction triggers, (3) delegate fires AFTER compaction, (4) return lands in post-compaction session. Timing order is critical: staged → compaction → fires → returns. Out-of-order = FAIL.
